name: Pyro Playground 💥 [UPDATE]
desc:
💥 Welcome to Pyro Playground, The ultimate simulator for pyrotechnics enthusiasts!

🧨 Unleash your inner pyro love and explore a vibrant world filled with firecrackers, rockets, and everything related to fireworks.

✨ Whether you're a seasoned pyrotechnician or a curious beginner, Pyro Playground offers endless excitement and explosive fun.

💰 Earn cash by lighting fireworks! Save cash to unlock new firecrackers!
⚠️ Get a VIP Server for free if you are experiencing lag in a public server ⚠️
